name: Neurology & migraine care (category guide)
summary: Migraine / vertigo / neuropathy — GP first vs neurologist, imaging pre-auth traps, and when sudden neurological symptoms are A&E not a boutique clinic.
body: Neurology is for migraine that fails simple care, unexplained vertigo, seizures, and neuropathy — not every headache needs an MRI package. Sudden worst-ever headache, weakness, or speech change is A&E first. Stable migraine work-ups can start with a GP; escalate to SMC Neurology when preventives, Botox pathways, or specialised testing enter the chat. Public hospital private-patient booking exists; foreigners pay full fees. Private centres sell speed — still ask which tests are diagnostic vs wellness. Insurers often gate MRI/CT behind referral and pre-auth. Distinct from ENT vertigo pathways and from psychiatry medication listings. Category guide, not a ranked neurologist list.
